name: Bitbinders Relocation Quote Estimator
author: bitbinders

sections.description:
Bitbinders Relocation Quote Estimator is a powerful, professional-grade moving and relocation estimator designed for moving companies, logistics providers, and relocation specialists. It allows your customers to dynamically calculate the cost of their move based on either the total volume (CFT) of their inventory or a flat item-based pricing model.

Built with a stunning, modern glassmorphism interface, Bitbinders Relocation Quote Estimator not only provides an interactive experience for your users but also acts as a highly effective lead generation tool.

Key Features:
* Dynamic Distance Calculation: Integrates with OpenRouteService to calculate accurate driving distances between origin and destination.
* Volume or Flat Pricing: Choose to charge customers based on a Rate per Cubic Foot (CFT) or by a flat rate per item.
* Customizable Inventory: Build a robust catalog of items (e.g., standard sofa, queen bed) with assigned volumes and prices.
* Lead Vault Dashboard: Automatically captures all submitted quotes (including customer name, email, phone, route, and inventory manifest) in a secure backend dashboard.
* CSV Export: Export your captured leads to CSV for easy import into your CRM.
* Automated Notifications: Send customizable confirmation emails to your customers and alert emails to your admin team when a new quote is generated.
* Multi-Currency Support: Configure the calculator to use your local currency symbol ($, €, £, etc.).
* Responsive Design: A beautiful, responsive interface that looks incredible on desktop and mobile.

External services

This plugin connects to external APIs to accurately calculate driving distances and geocode addresses.

It sends the origin and destination addresses provided by the user to calculate the optimal route distance.
* OpenRouteService: Used for calculating the driving distance between the origin and destination coordinates. Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
* Photon by Komoot: Used for geocoding the addresses (converting the user-entered text addresses into geographic coordinates). Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bitbinders-relocation-quote-estimator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin by uploading the zip file directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new ‘Quote Estimator Settings’ menu in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. (Optional) Enter your free OpenRouteService API key in the General Setup tab for precise driving distance calculations.
  5. Add items to your Master Items Directory to build your inventory catalog.
  6. Use the shortcode [Bitbinders Relocation Quote Estimator] on any page or post to display the calculator to your users.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenRouteService API key?

It is highly recommended for accurate driving distances. However, if you do not provide an API key, the plugin will gracefully fall back to calculating the straight-line (Haversine) distance between the two points, multiplied by a standard curvature coefficient.

How do I customize the emails?

Go to Quote Estimator Settings -> Email Configuration. You can enable/disable admin alerts and customer confirmation emails. You can use dynamic tags like {name}, {price}, and {inventory} to personalize the messages.

Where do I find the submitted quotes?

All submitted quotes are securely saved in the “Lead Vault” found under the Quote Estimator Settings menu.
